# ThreeRouter

> ThreeRouter is an enterprise-grade AI API unified management platform. One API key to access DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax and more. Fully compatible with the OpenAI API format. Features include L1-L5 smart routing, fine-grained token management, team quota control, and security compliance audit. US-based deployment, up to 97% cost reduction, P99 latency under 200ms.

## Core Capabilities

- **Unified API access**: Fully compatible with the OpenAI API format — just replace the base URL and API key
- **Multi-model support**: DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM, Seedance video generation, and more
- **Smart routing**: L1-L5 routing engine that automatically matches the best value model based on task complexity
- **Cost optimization**: Smart routing cuts average cost by 40-80%; standard pricing is 30%+ below official prices
- **Enterprise token management**: Four-dimensional quota control by department / team / project / API key, with cost attribution and usage analytics
- **Security & compliance**: TLS 1.3 encrypted transport, no request data stored, GDPR / EU AI Act compliant
- **High availability**: 99.9% SLA with multi-provider routing and failover

## Technical Information

- **API endpoint**: https://api.threerouter.com/v1
- **Compatible format**: OpenAI API (Chat Completions, Embeddings, etc.)
- **SDK support**: Python, Node.js, Go, Java
- **Agent frameworks**: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Dify
- **Authentication**: Bearer Token (API Key)
- **Deployment**: Cloud SaaS / dedicated instance / on-premise

## FAQ

- Enterprise onboarding: completed within 1 business day (account setup → team configuration → key distribution → start calling)
- Data security: end-to-end encryption, no request/response data stored, never used for model training
- SLA: 99.9% availability for enterprise customers, with contractual compensation if not met
- Payment: WeChat Pay and Alipay supported, 1 CNY = 1 USD
- New user offers: $2 free credits on signup, $10 for joining the community, up to ¥160 bonus on first top-up
